protocol.question: Matched Rust/C++ CPU/GPU comparison for supplied masks and linear HDR, retaining fixed/active-render controls
protocol.maximum: SDK Quality render-size query, checked against live context
protocol.smaller: Live-context SDK Performance render-size query, strictly inside maximum; Rust additionally cross-checks its pre-create query
protocol.creation: Dynamic resolution enabled in every workload; identical fixed maximum allocations and output; explicit exposure, linear SDR, local owner
protocol.ordering: Odd blocks: max,small,transition with C++ then Rust; even blocks: transition,small,max with Rust then C++
protocol.scene: RGBA16F ramp: R=.1+.75*((x+.5-jx)/active_width-frame/max_width), G=.1+.75*(y+.5-jy)/active_height, B=.2, A=1; depth .5; inactive colour/motion guards 65504 and depth 1
protocol.motion: UV current-to-previous, zero on frame 0 then (-1/max_width,0); native scale equals active dimensions; fixed output-space trajectory
protocol.history: One context per process, reset only frame 0; jitter phase queried separately for each size, offset index=global frame modulo current phase; no query in timed loop
protocol.checks: Untouched output sentinel; restore sentinel at each checkpoint; complete finite/written RGBA output, exact read-only colour/depth/motion input guards, output/input FNV-1a equality between matched consumers; final output SHA-256; device/debug diagnostics and terminal cleanup
protocol.input_oracle: At each checkpoint sample GPU-readback colour/depth/motion at (0,0), (active_width-1,active_height-1), and (active_width,active_height) when inactive. Independent Python analytic scene/motion prediction: one relative binary16 step plus 1e-6 for binary32 arithmetic; depth/alpha/inactive guards exact. Full input readback bytes also match uploads; samples do not prove every generated texel analytically correct.
protocol.diagnostics: Separate debug controls require zero debug errors. Timed processes disable the debug layer; UINT64_MAX denotes an unavailable info queue and is never reported as zero observed errors. Device-removal checks remain mandatory.
protocol.stable_matching: Transition and corresponding stable-size controls must have identical full input hashes, sampled inputs and jitter at each checkpoint. Outputs must also match before the shrink, while histories are identical; no cross-history output equality is required afterwards.
protocol.timing: P04 same-queue FSR timestamps and separate QPC dispatch interval; upload, queries, sentinel restoration, resolve, fencing, input/output readback, hashing and logging excluded; identical checkpoint schedule in stable controls
protocol.interpretation: Report signed Rust-minus-C++ CPU/GPU distributions for each workload and feature-minus-SDR differences per consumer/block. No equivalence/non-inferiority margin or speed gate is selected. Mask consumption/benefit, non-linear colour semantics, general HDR pipeline, quality, FPS, throughput and broader hardware support remain outside scope.

features.masks: Maximum active region; both R8_UNORM masks supplied together, static render-aligned rectangles created once before timing: reactive=128 where .25<u<.5, transparency/composition=255 where .5<v<.75, otherwise zero. Full mask GPU readbacks match uploads and an independently generated complete FNV-1a hash.
features.hdr: Maximum active region; native HDR creation bit, linear RGBA16F ramp RGB multiplied by 8, alpha 1; exposure/pre-exposure fixed at 1, no encoding hint. Independent GPU input sample oracle uses the same declared scale; each checkpoint output maximum red must be finite, greater than 1 and less than 64.

protocol.matching: Reuse P05's allocation sizes, scene trajectory, timing boundaries, history/reset, jitter, checkpoints and process orders extended to five workloads. Exact Rust/C++ canonical descriptors include both mask resources or HDR creation flag. Compare within identical workload/history-length cohorts; masked base inputs match the same-index SDR maximum control. HDR colour differs deliberately, depth/motion/exposure settings remain unchanged.
protocol.success: 62 required cases: shared setup, ten debug children, forty timed children in four balanced blocks and one combined analysis; 50 native processes/6440 submitted-fenced frames. Complete matched valid execution, exact full mask hashes, audited colour/depth/motion samples, output/synchronization/cleanup and timing records are required.

active_controls.limit: One frame per transition per process; correlated frame samples are not independent process repetitions. Serial fences/checkpoint readbacks can affect subsequent clocks.

limit: Descriptive independent process blocks; correlated frames, uncontrolled clocks and diagnostic gaps; no speed-parity claim.
